fichas.title: Hospital Laundry: Clean and Soiled Separation
fichas.summary: Guidance and plans for separating hospital laundry into soiled and clean areas. The soiled area must allow damp-cleaning and disinfection of floors, walls, and external surfaces of built-in equipment and machines. Passages between the two sides require personnel control lobbies, hand disinfection, protective clothing provision, and doors that cannot both be opened at once. The page illustrates a disinfection cubicle with single-door washing machines and a room-separated arrangement.
uses: Separate handling of soiled and clean laundry

fichas.summary: Laundry plan for a centre for the elderly, organized with soiled and clean sides and designated washing, drying, ironing, pressing, and repair functions.

fichas.summary: Reference tables list average garment and linen weights for washing, including clothing for men, women, children, bathing, bed linen, table linen, and work clothes.
